AGENDA

  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.

minutes_text:
CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  MINUTES
  February 12, 2025
  City Council Chambers

1.  ROLL CALL
  Chair Ghazarian called the meeting to order at 5:01 pm.

  Present: Rihn, Megrabyan, Hatamian, Chair Ghazarian
  Absent: None

2.  MINUTES
  Action: Consideration for the minutes of the January 15, 2025 meetings.

  Motion: Rihn  Second: Megrabyan
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items NOT a part of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to five minutes. Commission
  may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

4.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT
  Paula Adams reviewed the Recruitment and Examination Report.

5.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED
  Paula Adams reviewed the Eligible Lists Established Report.

6.  REORGANIZATION OF THE COMMISSION
  Action: Select a new Chair and Vice Chair.

  Chair Ghazarian nominated Commissioner Hatamian for Commission Chair.
  Second: Megrabyan
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Chair Hatamian accepted the nomination.

  Commissioner Ghazarian nominated Commissioner Megrabyan for Commission Vice Chair.
  Second: Hatamian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Vice Chair Megrabyan accepted the nomination.

7.  REVISED CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL FIREFIGHTER RECRUIT
  —

  Action: Approve revised class specification series for Firefighter Recruit as submitted.

  Commissioner Ghazarian made an amendment to the educational minimum requirement and recommended
  the following language: “Graduation from high school or attainment of a State Board of Education issued
  certificate of proficiency, or attainment of GED certificate, CHSPE certificate, HiSET certificate, or CPP
  certificate.”
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of February 12, 2025
  Page 2of4

  Chair Hatamian had requested that staff bring back a report discussing the high school education
  requirements at a later time.
  Motion: Ghazarian  Second: Megrabyan
  Vote: Ayes: Ghazarian, Megrabyan, Hatamian
  No: Rihn

8.  NEW CLASS 5PECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL PARKING METER TECHNICIAN
  —

  Action: Approve the class specification series for Parking Meter Technician as submitted.

  Commissioner Chazarian made an amendment to the educational minimum requirement and recommended
  the following language: “Graduation from high school or attainment of a State Board of Education issued
  certificate of proficiency, or attainment of GED certificate, CHSPE certificate, HiSET certificate, or CPP
  certificate.”
  Motion: Ghazarian  Second: Megrabyan
  Vote: Ayes: Ghazarian, Megrabyan, Hatamian
  No: Rihn

9.  NEW CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL TRAFFIC MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN SERIES
  —

  Action: Approve the new classifications for Traffic Maintenance Technician Series as submitted.

  Commissioner Ghazarian made an amendment to the educational minimum requirement and recommended
  the following language: “Graduation from high school or attainment of a State Board of Education issued
  certificate of proficiency, or attainment of GED certificate, CHSPE certificate, HiSET certificate, or CPP
  certificate.”

  Motion: Chazarian  Second: Megrabyan
  Vote: Ayes: Ghazarian, Megrabyan, Hatamian
  No: Rihn

10.  NEW CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL  — CYBERSECURIW ENGINEER SERIES
  Action: Approve the revised class specification series for Cybersecurity Engineer Series as submitted.

  Commissioner Ghazarian made an amendment to the educational minimum requirement and recommended
  the following language: “Graduation from high school or attainment of a State Board of Education issued
  certificate of proficiency, or attainment of GED certificate, CHSPE certificate, HiSET certificate, or CPP
  certificate.”
  Motion: Chazarian  Second: Megrabyan
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of February 12, 2025
  Page 3 of4

11.  NEW CLASS SPECIFICATION SERIES FOR APPROVAL NETWORK ENGINEER
  —

  Action: Approve the revised class specification series for Network Engineer as submitted.

  Commissioner Ghazarian made an amendment to the educational minimum requirement and recommended
  the following language: “Graduation from high school or attainment of a State Board of Education issued
  certificate of proficiency, or attainment of GED certificate, CHSPE certificate, HiSET certificate, or CPP
  certificate.”

  Motion: Ghazarian  Second: Megrabyan
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

12.  REPORTS INFORMATION
  -

  a) Employee iob Performance Evaluations Past Due Aging Report

  Paula Adams reviewed the Employee Job Performance Evaluations Past Due Aging Reports.

13.  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  Commissioner Rihn asked if the Civil Service Commission was expected to present an annual report to the
  City Council, in accordance with the City Charter. Paula Adams indicated that during the budget discussions
  Human Resources reports out on operations to the City Council. In addition, Ms. Adams stated that a
  vacancies report will be presented during the budget discussions as well. Principal Assistant City Attorney
  Lucy Varpetian stated that she will need to look into this area. Commissioner Ghazarian stated that he does
  not recall ever making an annual report to the City Council.

  Chair Hatamian asked if a report is presented to the Commission that would list the number of disciplinary
  cases. Ms. Adams indicated no.

14.  CLOSED SESSION
  a. Reinstatement  —  Police Officer
  b. Reinstatement  —  Police Officer

  Reporting Out
  a. Reinstatement The Commission voted unanimously to place the former employee on the reinstatement
  —

  list for Police Officer.
  b. Reinstatement The Commission voted unanimously to place the former employee on the reinstatement
  —

  list for Police Dfficer.
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of February 12, 2025
  Page 4of4

14.  ADJOURNMENT
  Action: Move to adjourn.

  There being no further business to come before the Commission, the meeting was adjourned at 6:51 pm.

  We, the members of the Civil Service Commission of the City of Glendale, certify that the foregoing Minutes
  are a true and correct record of our proceedings of February 12, 2025.
